annotations.title: Flat prices in Polish cities: ranking from notarial deeds

description: Use for the cheapest or the most expensive cities to buy a flat in Poland, and for flat prices per m2 in a city that is not one of the 17 large cities, for example Gliwice, Toruń or Częstochowa. For districts of a large city, use get_housing_prices. Median flat transaction price per m² from notarial deeds (RCN) in Polish cities with at least 200 deeds in the last 4 full quarters and no quarter gaps, from the cheapest: quartiles, median flat area and price, secondary and primary market, year-over-year change and the median asking price per m² in developer price lists (dane.gov.pl) in the same city. Without city: the cheapest and the most expensive cities, the number of cities and all cities with their median. With city: that city with its rank and quarterly medians (all markets, secondary, primary). Aggregates only, no individual deeds.

city.description: City name or slug (e.g. "Kraków" or "krakow") for one city with its rank and quarterly medians; omit for the ranking.
